rows.text: The item of 30 December 2010 says that the King granted a life peerage 'to Dr. Viliami Ta'u Tangi, interim Health Minister and Deputy Prime Minister', invested as Lord Tangi of Vaonukonuka on the evening of Thursday 30 December 2010.
rows.uncertainty: The latest dated record found styling him Deputy Prime Minister. 'interim' is printed before 'Health Minister'; whether it also qualifies 'Deputy Prime Minister' is not stated. It falls after Lord Tu'ivakano's appointment audience of 22 December 2010 and before the new Cabinet commenced on 4 January 2011; no end of his deputy premiership is inferred from either. The peerage is not an office of this role.

rows.text: The same item says: 'In May 2006 His Majesty King Taufa'ahau Tupou IV appointed Dr. Tangi as Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Health'.
rows.uncertainty: Retrospective and month only: it gives no day, supplies no start and is never a holder date. No end of Cocker's office is inferred from it.
